options.text: Understand leader-follower, multi-leader and leaderless models, synchronous versus asynchronous acknowledgment, lag, failover and split-brain prevention.

runs.t: Which practical project example best illustrates

options.text: A guest list page issuing one query per booking can be changed to a batched join or prefetch. Verify that pagination and permissions still behave correctly after the change.
Renaming guest.fullName to firstName and lastName requires a transitional writer or mapper, backfill of old records and validation before deleting the original field.

Two workers check whether a room is available and both create a booking. Read committed alone may not protect the invariant; uniqueness/exclusion constraints, locking or serializable transactions may be necessary.
A news site serves most reads from replicas, while editorial publishing routes writes through a leader. After publishing, an editor may require routing to the primary until the update is visible.
